description: Reopen r-sort-3-keys-mdb (MDB) read-only. Table-type recordsets walk reading ID: LK by each of its eight compound indexes forward and IX_KN backward; LK2 by IX_KN and IX_KND; FR by each of its seven compound indexes forward and IX_FKN backward. Asks the physical traversal order, tie order and Null placement of fresh versus incrementally built compound indexes, including keys that reach the 510-byte region.
retentionNote: Designed r-sort-3 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
